scenes.headline: BATTERIES AT A GLANCE
scenes.depicts: See your wireless battery levels right on your Windows taskbar. Meet Wireless Battery.

scenes.headline: YOUR DEVICES. ONE VIEW.
scenes.depicts: It brings supported mice, headsets, keyboards, and controllers into one glance, without opening a pile of vendor apps.

scenes.headline: LOW OR CHARGING?
scenes.depicts: A red number warns you when a device hits fifteen percent or less. A blue bolt shows when it is charging.

scenes.headline: INSTALL. CHECK SUPPORT.
scenes.depicts: Download the installer from the project’s GitHub releases and run it. Check the supported device list first. Not every model works.

scenes.headline: YOUR CALL
scenes.depicts: It is free and open source. Comment BATTERY and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
